title: Explanatory Note to the Equity Statement: Allocation Holds and the Restatement Window on Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
A member reading an equity statement under Membership and Patronage Equity may find the year's allocation shown as held, or may wish to know how far back a posted allocation can still be put right. Two figures of the class govern both, and they are set out here.

| Class | Longest an allocation may be held while a restatement is worked, calendar days | Fiscal years back within which an allocation may still be restated |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 60 | 3 |
| Class A Voting Membership | 60 | 3 |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 60 | 3 |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 90 | 3 |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 60 | 3 |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 120 | 3 |

**The hold.** The figure in the second column is counted in calendar days from the day the hold was set. Four classes carry 60 days, one carries 90 and one carries 120.

**The window.** The figure in the third column is 3 fiscal years on every class of Membership and Patronage Equity, counted in whole fiscal years back from the current fiscal year, the boundary year itself falling inside the window.

**Boundary cases on hypothetical dates.** A hold set on a Class A Voting Membership and standing 59 calendar days is inside that class's figure of 60; standing 61 calendar days it is beyond it. On the Estate Retirement Equity Holding the same hold would still be inside the class's figure of 120 at 61 days.
